miccai.description:
Segmentation of brain regions in MRI scans of 6-month-old children on Colab, using 10 patient volumes containing T1, T2, and ground-truth data.
A cascaded U-Net architecture was employed (identifying brain location, then separating CSF from gray and white matter, followed by separating gray matter from white matter), with the Dice score used for validation.
The dataset comprised 6 training, 2 testing, and 2 validation patients.
